//@version=6
indicator("Absorption Levels & VWAP Reversal", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500)

// --- Inputs ---
// EMA Settings
emaLen = input.int(21, "EMA Length", group="Moving Averages", tooltip="Short-term momentum filter.")

// VWAP Settings
mult1 = input.float(1.0, "VWAP Band 1 Multiplier", group="VWAP & Bands")
mult2 = input.float(2.0, "VWAP Band 2 Multiplier", group="VWAP & Bands")

// Absorption Settings
volSpikeMult = input.float(1.5, "Volume Spike Multiplier", group="Absorption Logic", tooltip="Current volume must be this many times the SMA of volume.")
volSmaLen = input.int(14, "Volume SMA Length", group="Absorption Logic")
ltf = input.timeframe("1", "Lower Timeframe for Intrabar Volume", group="Absorption Logic", tooltip="Used to calculate intrabar volume delta inside the wicks.")
volThreshold = input.float(0.4, "Wick Volume Threshold", minval=0.1, maxval=1.0, group="Absorption Logic", tooltip="Fraction (e.g., 0.4 = 40%) of total volume that must occur within the wick zone to trigger absorption.")
maxZoneBars = input.int(20, "Max Zone Length (Bars)", group="Absorption Logic", tooltip="Maximum number of bars the zone will extend if not broken.")
breakLogic = input.string("Past Midline", "Zone Breakout Logic", options=["Past Midline", "Past Full Zone"], group="Absorption Logic", tooltip="Determines what constitutes breaking the zone.")

// Style Settings
bullAbsColor = input.color(#089981, "Bullish Absorption Color", group="Style")
bearAbsColor = input.color(#e91e63, "Bearish Absorption Color", group="Style")
emaUpColor = input.color(#089981, "EMA Up Color", group="Style")
emaDownColor = input.color(#9c27b0, "EMA Down Color", group="Style")
upperBandColor = input.color(#089981, "Upper Bands Color", group="Style")
lowerBandColor = input.color(#f23645, "Lower Bands Color", group="Style")

// --- Moving Average ---
ema = ta.ema(close, emaLen)
emaColor = ema > ema[1] ? emaUpColor : ema < ema[1] ? emaDownColor : emaUpColor
plot(ema, "EMA", color=emaColor, linewidth=2)

// --- Daily Anchored VWAP & Standard Deviations ---
var float sumVol = 0.0
var float sumSrcVol = 0.0
var float sumSrc2Vol = 0.0

isNewDay = ta.change(time("D")) != 0

if isNewDay
    sumVol := 0.0
    sumSrcVol := 0.0
    sumSrc2Vol := 0.0

src = hlc3
sumVol += volume
sumSrcVol += src * volume
sumSrc2Vol += src * src * volume

vwapVal = sumSrcVol / math.max(sumVol, 1)
variance = (sumSrc2Vol / math.max(sumVol, 1)) - (vwapVal * vwapVal)
// Ensure variance is not negative due to floating point inaccuracies
stdev = math.sqrt(math.max(0, variance))

// We plot 'na' on the first bar of the new day to break the continuous line from the previous day
plotVwap = isNewDay ? na : vwapVal
plotUpper1 = isNewDay ? na : vwapVal + stdev * mult1
plotLower1 = isNewDay ? na : vwapVal - stdev * mult1
plotUpper2 = isNewDay ? na : vwapVal + stdev * mult2
plotLower2 = isNewDay ? na : vwapVal - stdev * mult2

plot(plotVwap, "Daily VWAP", color=color.new(color.yellow, 0), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(plotUpper1, "Upper Band 1", color=color.new(upperBandColor, 40), style=plot.style_linebr, linestyle=plot.linestyle_dashed, linewidth=1)
plot(plotLower1, "Lower Band 1", color=color.new(lowerBandColor, 40), style=plot.style_linebr, linestyle=plot.linestyle_dashed, linewidth=1)
plot(plotUpper2, "Upper Band 2", color=color.new(upperBandColor, 60), style=plot.style_linebr, linestyle=plot.linestyle_dashed, linewidth=1)
plot(plotLower2, "Lower Band 2", color=color.new(lowerBandColor, 60), style=plot.style_linebr, linestyle=plot.linestyle_dashed, linewidth=1)

// --- Multi-Timeframe Volume Delta Logic ---
isVolSpike = volume > ta.sma(volume, volSmaLen) * volSpikeMult

bodySize = math.abs(close - open)
rangeSize = high - low
isCompression = bodySize < rangeSize * 0.4 // Wick dominance / spread compression

// Retrieve lower timeframe data arrays
ltfVols = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, ltf, volume)
ltfHighs = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, ltf, high)
ltfLows = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, ltf, low)

float bearishWickVol = 0.0
float bullishWickVol = 0.0

// Define the "wick zones" where we look for massive execution
topZone = high - rangeSize * 0.3
botZone = low + rangeSize * 0.3

if array.size(ltfVols) > 0
    for i = 0 to array.size(ltfVols) - 1
        ltfH = array.get(ltfHighs, i)
        ltfL = array.get(ltfLows, i)
        ltfV = array.get(ltfVols, i)
        // Approximate execution price for the LTF candle
        ltfMid = (ltfH + ltfL) / 2.0
        
        if ltfMid >= topZone
            bearishWickVol += ltfV
        if ltfMid <= botZone
            bullishWickVol += ltfV

// Bullish Absorption (Buying exhaustion by passive buyers)
// Surges into support, closes near top, high volume in bottom wick
isBullishAbs = isVolSpike and isCompression and (bullishWickVol >= volume * volThreshold) and (close > high - rangeSize * 0.5)

// Bearish Absorption (Selling exhaustion by passive sellers)
// Surges into resistance, closes near bottom, high volume in top wick
isBearishAbs = isVolSpike and isCompression and (bearishWickVol >= volume * volThreshold) and (close < low + rangeSize * 0.5)

// --- Visualizing Absorption Levels ---
type AbsZone
    box bx
    float topVal
    float botVal
    bool isBullish

var zones = array.new<AbsZone>()

if isBearishAbs
    // Mark the upper wick area where passive sellers absorbed aggressive buyers
    topVal = high
    botVal = math.max(open, close)
    bx = box.new(bar_index, topVal, bar_index + 1, botVal, border_color=na, bgcolor=color.new(bearAbsColor, 40))
    array.push(zones, AbsZone.new(bx, topVal, botVal, false))

if isBullishAbs
    // Mark the lower wick area where passive buyers absorbed aggressive sellers
    botVal = low
    topVal = math.min(open, close)
    bx = box.new(bar_index, topVal, bar_index + 1, botVal, border_color=na, bgcolor=color.new(bullAbsColor, 40))
    array.push(zones, AbsZone.new(bx, topVal, botVal, true))

// Manage dynamic extending boxes (stop extending when price closes past them)
if array.size(zones) > 0
    for i = array.size(zones) - 1 to 0
        z = array.get(zones, i)
        broken = false
        
        // Check how many bars the zone has been extending
        barsActive = bar_index - box.get_left(z.bx)
        if barsActive >= maxZoneBars
            broken := true
        
        if not broken
            // Extend the right side of the box to the current bar
            box.set_right(z.bx, bar_index + 1)
            
            midline = (z.topVal + z.botVal) / 2.0
            
            if z.isBullish
                if breakLogic == "Past Midline"
                    if close < midline
                        broken := true
                else
                    if close < z.botVal
                        broken := true
            else
                if breakLogic == "Past Midline"
                    if close > midline
                        broken := true
                else
                    if close > z.topVal
                        broken := true
                    
        if broken
            // Stop extending by removing from active array
            array.remove(zones, i)
